articles.summary: Customers keep using Field & Main branches, cards and apps as usual after the merger. Full systems integration is scheduled for Oct. 17, 2026.
articles.title: Stock Yards Bancorp Completes Acquisition of Field & Main Bancorp

articles.summary: Dividend of $0.32 per share will be paid July 1, 2026 to holders on June 15, 2026; Louisville-based Stock Yards Bancorp reports $9.47B in assets.
articles.title: Stock Yards Bancorp Declares Quarterly Cash Dividend Of $0.32 Per Common Share
